title: Machamp's Four Arms Are Its Greatest Strength and Weakness
premise: Machamp's four arms make it overwhelming in combat, but create a surprising weakness during delicate work.
audiencePromise: See why Machamp's extra arms dominate fights, then backfire when precision matters.
openLoop: How can Machamp's greatest combat advantage become a weakness?
payoff: Four arms give Machamp combat supremacy, but careful finger work makes those same arms tangle.
engagementQuestion: Are four arms a superpower or a precision problem?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan telling a friend something surprising. Keep the pace quick, warm, and playful. Stress the contrast between combat power and delicate-work clumsiness. Pause briefly before the final either-or question.

scenes.headline: POWER BECOMES A PROBLEM
scenes.narration: Machamp's greatest strength is its worst weakness.
scenes.caption: FOUR ARMS. TWO VERY DIFFERENT RESULTS.

scenes.headline: NO SAFE ANGLE
scenes.narration: Four arms let Machamp punch and chop from every angle.
scenes.caption: ATTACKS FROM ALL ANGLES

scenes.headline: GRABBED, THEN FINISHED
scenes.narration: It can grab a foe with all four arms, nearly ending the battle.
scenes.caption: THE MACHAMP SPECIAL

scenes.headline: OFFENSE AND DEFENSE
scenes.narration: Attack and defense happen together, giving Machamp close-combat supremacy.
scenes.caption: OFFENSE + DEFENSE AT ONCE

scenes.headline: PRECISION IS DIFFERENT
scenes.narration: Yet careful finger work is exactly where Machamp struggles.
scenes.caption: DELICATE WORK GOES WRONG

scenes.headline: SUPERPOWER OR PROBLEM?
scenes.narration: Are four arms a superpower or a precision problem?
scenes.caption: WHAT WOULD YOU RATHER HAVE?
